_comment: Authoritative macOS-platform sources cited by the cross-platform work (docs/MACOS.md findings D1-D6/E1-E3, docs/DEPLOYMENT_SURFACES.md, the mac-lint guard). Freshness-tracked by tools/source_currency.py (--check/--summary/--offline --domain macos-sources; --update-baselines after human review, run where the network is open). These are reference citations backing platform claims - nothing here is fetched into the product. Citing a new external source in a maintainer-class doc requires registering it here (or in another source registry / tools/url-provenance.json) - enforced by tools/sync_check.py check 20. Supersession keywords are deliberately phrase-level (not bare 'deprecated'/'archived') because reference pages legitimately use those words in prose. authority: 'primary' = the platform's own documentation; 'secondary' = community/forum material - treat its claims as verify-on-device. Nothing fabricated. NOTE: prefer a full timezone-aware ISO timestamp for state.last_checked (e.g. 2026-07-16T00:00:00+00:00); a bare date is interpreted as UTC midnight.
